description.value: Firehouse Subs is a Canadian sandwich chain built around hot, steamed subs and a charitable mission: its Public Safety Foundation of Canada has donated over $6.3 million in equipment grants to first responders nationwide. The Pitt Meadows franchise sits in the Meadowtown retail area along the Lougheed Highway, a key east–west corridor for cyclists connecting the Lower Mainland to the Fraser Valley. It is a no-drive-through, takeout-friendly counter-service stop with a gluten-free roll option available.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 95m. Total: 2 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Firehouse Subs Canada is an active chain with online ordering and takeout; the OSM tag 'takeaway=yes' and the website's multiple 'Order Now' prompts corroborate takeout. The website explicitly lists a 'Gluten Free Roll' menu option, confirming a GF item. No location-specific page was accessible from the corporate site, so the Pitt Meadows phone number and address cannot be confirmed via website; the OSM opening_hours string also appears malformed and is flagged as a concern.
concerns: OSM opening_hours appear malformed: 'Mo-Tu 10:00-12:00; We 10:00-08:00; Th off; Fr-Su 10:00-12:00' — Thursday listed as closed and closing time of 12:00 likely should be 22:00; needs on-the-ground verification.
Website is the national corporate site only; no location-specific page was reachable to confirm the Pitt Meadows phone number or street address independently.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active fast-food franchise on a major cycling corridor in Pitt Meadows; looks_closed is false and the corporate website confirms the brand is actively operating in Canada.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website lists 'Gluten Free Roll' as a menu option under Orders & Rewards navigation

wow_evidence: Canadian sandwich chain built around hot, steamed subs
